title: astragalus tataricus
intro: Astragalus tataricus, commonly known as Huangqi, is a plant species within the legume family native to China. It is a perennial herb used in traditional Chinese medicine to promote overall health and well-being. The health benefits of Astragalus tataricus include its immunomodulatory, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which help to enhance immune function, reduce inflammation, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of the plant include saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of tonifying Qi, improving cardiovascular health, and modulating immune responses.
